num_connections.description: Maximum number of connections to use per download.

max_speed.description: Maximum average download speed in bytes per second (0 = unlimited).

max_redirect.description: Maximum number of HTTP redirections to follow.

timeout.description: I/O and connection timeout in seconds.

no_clobber.description: Skip download if destination file already exists (no state file present).

verbose.description: Verbosity level (0 = quiet unless `quiet` is set; >0 adds `verbose` lines, one per level).

headers.description: List of HTTP headers to add (format: "Header: Value").

user_agent.description: Custom User-Agent string. Leave empty to use default (includes Axel version and platform).

search_default.description: Default number of mirrors to use when `-S` mirror search is invoked.
